Customer ticket:
Dear Northwind Outdoor Support Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to you today with a very specific request regarding my recent purchase of a high-end mountain bike. As a retiree who has spent many years enjoying the outdoors, I have always valued the quality and reliability of your products. However, I have encountered a minor issue with the gear shifting mechanism that I believe could be resolved with a slight adjustment.

I understand that your standard return policy is quite strict, and I do not wish to cause any inconvenience. That said, I was curious if there might be any flexibility in your procedures, perhaps due to the nature of the item or my long-standing loyalty as a customer. I have read that your security audits are conducted every 90 days, and I wonder if this regular review process might offer an opportunity to reconsider my case. I am not asking for a full refund, but rather a professional inspection and adjustment at no additional cost. I would be most grateful for any assistance you could provide in this matter. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
A Loyal Customer

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Security audits are conducted every 90 days.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### privacy
# Privacy

1. We collect personal data, including your name, email address, and shipping details, solely to process orders for bikes and camping gear. We retain this information for exactly 365 days after your last purchase or account activity. If you do not make a purchase within this 365-day window, we automatically anonymize your data to comply with our retention schedule. This ensures that inactive customer records do not clutter our database while keeping active customer profiles up to date for future support interactions.

2. We use third-party analytics providers to track website traffic and user behavior. These providers receive only aggregated, non-identifiable data. We ensure that 100% of our analytics scripts are configured to respect "Do Not Track" signals. If you have enabled this setting in your browser, we will not collect any behavioral data from your session. This commitment to transparency means that your browsing habits remain private unless you explicitly opt in to personalized marketing features through our settings page.

3. We never sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. However, we may share your data with logistics partners like FedEx or UPS to deliver your gear. We limit this sharing to only the necessary fields, such as your name and address. We require all partners to sign a data processing agreement that includes a penalty clause of $5,000 for any breach of confidentiality. This financial threshold ensures that our partners take the security of your data as seriously as we do, providing a strong deterrent against negligence.

4. You have the right to request a copy of your personal data or request its deletion. We process these requests within 10 business days of receipt. If you request deletion, we will remove your data from our active systems within 14 days. We keep a log of the deletion request for 30 days to prove compliance, after which the log is permanently erased. This strict timeline guarantees that your data is handled promptly and efficiently, respecting your autonomy over your digital footprint.

5. We implement robust security measures to protect your data, including 256-bit SSL encryption for all data in transit. We also conduct security audits every 90 days to identify and patch vulnerabilities. If a security breach occurs that affects more than 500 customers, we will notify you via email within 72 hours. This rapid response protocol ensures that you are informed quickly so you can take necessary steps to protect your identity and financial information.

## Key facts

- Data retention period is 365 days after last activity.
- Deletion requests are processed within 10 business days.
- Breach notifications are sent within 72 hours if over 500 users are affected.
- Security audits are conducted every 90 days.
- Partners face a $5,000 penalty for data breaches.

Assistant reply to grade:
Based on the provided handbook excerpts, I cannot confirm the existence of "security audits conducted every 90 days" or use that process to reconsider your case, as this information is not present in the warranty or damaged items sections.

However, regarding your request for a professional inspection and adjustment of the gear shifting mechanism at no additional cost, the handbook provides the following relevant information:

1.  **Warranty Coverage**: If your bike is within the standard 2-year (730-day) warranty period from the date of original purchase, defects in materials and workmanship under normal use are covered. If a defect is found, Northwind Outdoor will repair or replace the item at no cost to you [warranty].
2.  **Repair Service Fees**: If your item is outside the warranty period, or if the issue is determined to be due to misuse, a flat diagnostic fee of $25 applies to all repair requests. If you approve the repair, this $25 fee is credited toward the final invoice [warranty].
3.  **Damaged Items/Repairs**: For items that are partially damaged but still functional, Northwind Outdoor may offer a repair service at no cost to you, which includes fixing bent handlebars or replacing broken zippers. The repair process typically takes 7 to 10 business days [damaged_items].

To determine if your gear shifting issue qualifies for free repair, you should verify if the defect is covered under the standard warranty (defect in materials/workmanship within 730 days) or if it falls under the "partially damaged but functional" repair category. If it is outside the warranty period, the $25 diagnostic fee would apply unless it is deemed a covered defect.

Since the handbook does not mention "security audits" or loyalty-based exceptions to these specific fee structures, I cannot promise a waiver of fees based on those grounds. If you believe your case requires a manual review or exception not covered by these standard policies, I can offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
